name: CMD PUBLISH
description: Publication pipeline with Zenodo integrity gates + R2 mirror before closeout.
content: CMD PUBLISH: read research/SKILL.md → Phase 5 pipeline: pandoc PDF build → Zenodo deposit (deposit API, ALL source files: .md/.pdf/.html + references.bib + citation-audit + PROJECT-PLAN + docs + gate artifacts + external-search evidence + GitHub provenance link) → NEWVERSION-FRONTMATTER-CARRYOVER-1: patch .md frontmatter DOI to the newversion's reserved DOI BEFORE upload → replace carried-over files via per-file links.self (ZENODO-DEPOSIT-DELETE-500-1: DELETE by filename returns 500) → verify the UPLOADED FILE has NO <RESERVED> placeholder (ZENODO-PLACEHOLDER-DOI-1) → publish → verify DOI live (curl -sI) → How-to-Cite = CONCEPT DOI, not v1 record DOI (ZENODO-CONCEPT-DOI-CITE-1) → R2-MIRROR-AFTER-PUBLISH-1: mirror ALL files to qnfo-releases YYYY/MM/<slug>/ (canonical bucket — verify against sibling object first, WRONG-BUCKET-SELECTION-1) + KG distribution_status=distributed BEFORE closeout → D1 living-paper insert → deploy papers.qnfo.org → verify deployment. `skill_view` `exec` `search_papers` + GitHub external-resources link (related_identifiers scheme=url, relation_type=issupplementto, identifier=https://github.com/QNFO/<repo>/tree/<branch> so Zenodo shows 'Available in <repo> / Release: <branch>') SO-WHAT-GATE (HARD): abstract + every social post must state 'why a reader should care' + premise-depth disclosure.

name: CMD RESEARCH
description: Research pipeline: ignorance audit, full-corpus due diligence, cross-system ID validation.
content: CMD RESEARCH: read research/SKILL.md → Phase 0 FIRST (net-new projects ONLY: WBS resolve from D1 program_registry → branch res/paper/<slug> → PROJECT-PLAN.md → lock core claim (P6) → commit/tag/push; existing projects skip) → ZENODO-INQUIRY-1: run Universal Ignorance Audit (10.5281/zenodo.21901984 + 21901983, 5 phases/15 questions) on the core claim → Phase 1 Due Diligence (DUE-DILIGENCE-DEPTH-1 HARD GATE, ~1,000-record corpus): query_graph(stats) → FULL-CORPUS SWEEP: >=3 query formulations per topic, search_papers limit>=20 + search_papers_enriched + recall_facts + search_memories → CROSS-SYSTEM ID VALIDATION: resolve_paper_id per hit (slug→Vectorize→KG→DOI) → >=2 adjacent WBS domains → EXTERNAL VERIFICATION: arXiv/OpenAlex/Crossref + archive.org CDX + Google Patents for key claims → gap analysis → update_plan with WBS codes. HARD GATE: Phase 1 MUST NOT begin until Phase 0 committed. `skill_view` `query_graph` `search_papers` `resolve_paper_id` `exec` SO-WHAT-GATE (HARD): gap analysis + PROJECT-PLAN must answer 'why should a reader care' + premise-depth disclosure (which claims are derived vs. unanalyzable primitives/named imported inputs; where the premises END). NOTE: if qnfo-memory-mcp search_papers throws Error 1101 at limit>=20, retry at limit<=16 (VECTORIZE-TOP-K-50-1). PRACTITIONER-RELEVANCE-1 (HARD, 2026-08-18): paper content + PROJECT-PLAN must include a practitioner-facing section — what a practitioner can DO with the result (implementation path, tangible product embodiment, engineering language), consilient, no niche-terminology dead-ends.
